SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status != 7 AND DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS todayOrderCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN (2,3,4,5,6) AND DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() THEN pay_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS todaySales, SUM(CASE WHEN status != 7 AND DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() - INTERVAL 1 DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS yesterdayOrderCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN (2,3,4,5,6) AND DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() - INTERVAL 1 DAY THEN pay_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS yesterdaySales, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pendingPaymentCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status IN (2,3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pendingShipmentCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS shippedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status != 7 AND YEARWEEK(create_time, 1) = YEARWEEK(NOW(), 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekOrderCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN (2,3,4,5,6) AND YEARWEEK(create_time, 1) = YEARWEEK(NOW(), 1) THEN pay_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS weekSales, SUM(CASE WHEN status != 7 AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS monthOrderCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN (2,3,4,5,6) AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m') THEN pay_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS monthSales, SUM(CASE WHEN status != 7 AND YEARWEEK(create_time, 1) = YEARWEEK(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 WEEK), 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lastWeekOrderCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN (2,3,4,5,6) AND YEARWEEK(create_time, 1) = YEARWEEK(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 WEEK), 1) THEN pay_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS lastWeekSales, SUM(CASE WHEN status != 7 AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lastMonthOrderCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN (2,3,4,5,6) AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m') THEN pay_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS lastMonthSales FROM oms_order
shop_id = #{shopId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oms_order_return_apply ra INNER JOIN oms_order o ON ra.order_id = o.id WHERE ra.status = 0
AND o.shop_id = #{shopId}

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(m.create_time) = CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS memberTodayCount, SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(m.create_time) = CURDATE() - INTERVAL 1 DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS memberYesterdayCount, SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(m.create_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS memberMonthCount, COUNT(*) AS memberTotalCount FROM ums_member m
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oms_order o WHERE o.member_id = m.id AND o.shop_id = #{shopId})
